findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_crash_report_logs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Return the activity logs captured before a specific crash report: console prints, app lifecycle events, memory warnings, and network requests/responses. Logs ar…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
